rationale: The response directly explains the meme-to-leader connection, names Xi Jinping, and specifies the timeframes (2013, 2017-2018 implicitly through Abe comparison) and the subsequent censorship of imagery and searches.
quote: Winnie the Pooh is censored at times on the Chinese internet because Chinese netizens used the character as a meme to mock or allude to President Xi Jinping. The association began around 2013, when an image comparing Xi walking with Barack Obama to Pooh walking with Tigger circulated online.
